title: SWSE Universal Droid Publication Source Record — draft 0.1
description: Full canonical replacement source vocabulary for published SWSE droids. Not a Foundry actor instance. Sparse fields + evidence-qualified nulls, fail-closed for mechanics. Derived from audited 14-book census and universal vehicle source schema. Not yet owner frozen.

identity.description: Published source identity is immutable; not identical to canonical family or runtime actor.

sourceEntryKey.description: Stable book-specific statblock identity; duplicates across books remain separate

droidFamilyKey.description: Underlying factory lineage, independently reconciled; null until proven Never inferred from name alone.

variantKey.description: Unique source-backed configuration/variant Never inferred from name alone.

baseModelSourceKey.description: Publication statblock for related model; never inferred from similar name Never inferred from name alone.

namedIndividual.description: True only for a printed individual named character

aliases.description: Alternate printed names; empty only if proven none

sourcePresentationIds.description: Linked protocol/source presentation refs; not duplicated entries

publication.description: Printed-source evidence; sourcebook specificity is preserved.

publicationKind.description: One printed publication identity; droid squad not factory chassis

sourceViews.description: Alternate protocol views as source evidence; not duplicated models

sourceRevision.description: Official errata or printing when verified

classification.description: Droid species/body/degree, actor authority and printed formats are distinct.

publishedDegree.description: 1-5 when printed; contextual heading is separate and must not be promoted

contextualDegreeHeading.description: Nearest section heading, not automatically the printed model degree

ruleEntityNature.description: Rules identity; not inferred from printed class names

sourceStatblockFormat.description: Raw census presentation (e.g. starship-scale-droid); do not discard original format identity

primaryActorAuthority.description: Use vehicle engine for autonomous vehicle droids

role.description: Published roles, not deduced from combat loadout

classTextRaw.description: Published class line, without inferring Force/organic identity

challenge.description: Challenge is printed data, not a license for derived formula.

geometry.description: Size, fighting space, reach and cover do not automatically derive from limb inventory.

reachSquares.description: Printed reach; limb count does not set it

abilities.description: Published scores, skills and senses, not derived mechanics or assumptions.

str.description: Printed STR score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

dex.description: Printed DEX score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

con.description: Printed CON score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

int.description: Printed INT score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

wis.description: Printed WIS score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

cha.description: Printed CHA score; null is NOT score zero. For no CON use fieldStates explicitly-none.

initiativePrinted.description: Printed Initiative total, never additive feat bonus

senses.description: Published senses; may be equipment or processor dependent

items.description: Understanding and speaking are separate capabilities

progression.description: Printed progression separate from new PC starting choices.

classLineRaw.description: Printed classes, levels, and slash ordering

classes.description: Source classes, not an eligibility proof

forcePoints.description: Printed Force Points; not proof of unrestricted Force eligibility

conditionalForceCapability.description: Specific exemptions for Shard/special droid combat programming

defenses.description: Printed defenses, without silently calculating from feats or sensors.

armorNote.description: Printed chassis armor and loadout context

conditionalDefenseRules.description: Conditional cover, shielding or other temporary defenses

durability.description: Stock max values only. Current HP is never in immutable published source.

maintenanceProfileRef.description: Droid maintenance profile, replica exemption, Shard shell etc Never inferred from name alone.

destructionRules.description: Specific self-destruct, detonator, or volatile power systems

movement.description: Printed speed and installed movement systems, not runtime activation state.

locomotionSystems.description: Independent installed locomotion systems and modes

specialMovement.description: Model-specific climb, run, leap, tether/hover etc

starshipMovementRef.description: Vehicle model source key if the record is vehicle format Never inferred from name alone.

anatomy.description: Body/occupant separation; physical components can be many and have no generic pool.

bodyPlatformKind.description: Body platform not necessarily creature identity

items.description: Physical location only; never a weapon/item modification-slot pool

locationKind.description: hand, tool arm, leg, internal bay etc

capacity.description: Only model-specific printed number, NOT universal slots

manipulatorCount.description: Printed functional manipulators, not inferred from walking legs

integratedWeapons.description: Physical weapon component IDs, not duplicate weapon profiles

occupantProfileRef.description: Separate Shard or other mind/body occupant profile when applicable Never inferred from name alone.

bodyTraits.description: Body-specific traits; do not assume ordinary droid universal package

processor.description: Processor/controller separate from degree, body and skill.

commandLink.description: Network, remote-control, signal-loss and command rules

memory.description: Memory capacity/erase restrictions supported by printed source

processorInstanceId.description: Installed processor component instance Never inferred from name alone.

controlHostRef.description: Explicit controller reference Never inferred from name alone.

programming.description: Published behavior; no inferred universal permission from missing restrictions.

combat.description: Attack expressions separate from physical mounts and trusted runtime attacks.

attackGroups.description: Published attacks only, not installed executable weapon rights

firingDelegation.description: Vehicle droid brain/crew gunnery rules; reuse vehicle engine

conditions.description: Model-specific tactics, action, or condition modifiers

capacity.description: Weight capacity/storage NOT physical attachment slots or equipment upgrades.

specialCapacityRules.description: Separate cargo/lift capacity modifiers and conditions

systems.description: Physical installed system instances; may be null if source provides no information.

factorySystems.description: Stable installed component IDs with factory evidence

systemPackageRef.description: Published chassis/starting package, not manufacturing recipe reconstruction Never inferred from name alone.

equipment.description: Droid-owned items reuse equipment store and its own upgrade slot rules.

items.description: Possession and item upgrade authority separate from physical chassis

itemRef.description: Existing Item equipment or weapon authority Never inferred from name alone.

componentInstanceId.description: Same integrated weapon, not a second entity Never inferred from name alone.

possessions.description: Published possessions; [] means source explicitly says none

chassisArmorRef.description: Source armor identity under Armor authority Never inferred from name alone.

deviceToDroidSourceRef.description: Scum & Villainy Droidification source identity if applicable Never inferred from name alone.

modifications.description: No universal numeric droid component-slot pool. Null does not mean modifications allowed.

publishedNonFactoryChanges.description: Identified installed additions/changes beyond factory baseline

availablePhysicalLocations.description: Only explicit per-model physical mount locations

droidModifications.description: Approved component/droid-system modification facts, separate from equipment slots

itemUpgradeAuthorityRefs.description: External Item-domain V2 modification registry references

pcConstruction.description: Creation rules are not NPC statblock inventory or runtime eligibility authorization.

heroEligibility.description: Published permission only; lack of prohibition is not allowance

creationRoute.description: Starting route never inferred from NPC class levels

pcIdentityKind.description: Separate occupant person and body platform

startingProfileRef.description: Source-backed PC creation profile; separate from printed NPC example Never inferred from name alone.

startingSelections.description: Selectable free systems/feats according to printed route

baseTraitPackageRef.description: Degree/chassis creation modifiers applied once Never inferred from name alone.

restrictions.description: Creation restrictions; absence never means permitted

vehicleLink.description: Vehicle-format droid links to vehicle SSOT; never duplicates vehicle statblock.

vehicleSourceEntryKey.description: Exact canonical vehicle authority key; no independent vehicle stats here Never inferred from name alone.

vehicleRulesRef.description: Existing vehicle combat/movement engine authority Never inferred from name alone.

droidTraitOverlayRefs.description: Droid-only traits applied to vehicle host after source certification

stockWeaponCertification.description: Must not infer trusted weapons from droid identity

economics.description: No inferred purchasability, price, cost multiplier or credit conversion.

forSale.description: True only if source says purchasable; null does NOT imply yes

priceNotes.description: Exact conditional costs; no guessed factor conversion

text.description: Player-facing summary separated from verbatim rule authority.

shortSummary.description: Derived concise, player-readable summary, never substitute canonical rules

publishedFlavor.description: Source-excerpt provenance constrained by publishing rights

mechanicsNotes.description: Source prose mechanical notes, source-verified vs derived distinguished

sourceWarnings.description: Printed tensions, OCR issues, duplicate presentations

exceptions.description: Do not correct or erase source inconsistencies.

sourceContradictions.description: Printed contradictions, including differing skill totals

unmappedFacts.description: Facts without a certified typed destination; block mechanical certification

fieldStates.description: JSON pointer -> evidence state. For EVERY persisted null value store a state; null never grants absence/permission. Unreviewed paths should be omitted, not filled with null.

rules.description: No second V2 rules engine. All effects keyed to source and existing runtime authority.

conditionalMechanics.description: Printed local or source-specific rule claims

globalRuleReferences.description: Stable existing engine rules, not copies of generic formulas

controllingSourceDecisionId.description: DROID-RULE-001 when applicable; other conflicts require owner/errata

certification.description: Identity, mechanical fidelity and Foundry runtime have separate gates.

sourceCitation.description: Publication-specific source citation. No inferred page if unverified.

page.description: Printed page number, not PDF index

textLine1Based.description: One-based line in searchable source TXT

sourceEntryKey.description: Publication-specific source identity Never inferred from name alone.

sourceRule.description: Source-scoped rules claim with no automatic runtime execution.

statement.description: Source-mechanical claim; use own text when public distribution is intended

scope.description: Exact model, size, host type or action condition

effectRef.description: Existing engine or registry effect identifier Never inferred from name alone.

executionStatus.description: Certification is independent of source text

precedenceDecisionId.description: Owner-approved controlling decision (not automatically inferred) Never inferred from name alone.

appliedTrait.description: Source claim for a model/creation trait, not a second rules engine.

traitId.description: Canonical rules-profile trait ref or source-local ID

value.description: Published value or text, when present

rulesRef.description: Existing droid/species/progression engine rule Never inferred from name alone.

enabledInRuntime.description: True only after independent mechanic certification

componentInstance.description: Installed physical droid-system item; never manufacture instances from generic text.

instanceId.description: Stable per-instance ID inside one record, not a manufacturer model key

catalogRef.description: Canonical equipment/droid-system authority reference Never inferred from name alone.

physicalLocationId.description: Physical location/attachment position; NEVER generic upgrade-slot count Never inferred from name alone.

mountRef.description: Exact equipment/weapon mount identity Never inferred from name alone.

count.description: Only explicitly printed number of component instances; count does not grant actions

isFactoryInstalled.description: True only if printed as factory-equipped; not assumed by a statblock example

isActiveByDefault.description: True/false only if source establishes activation default

notes.description: Printed equipment/system context and unresolved mappings

attackExpression.description: One printed attack expression; contains no trusted Foundry attack rights.

attackId.description: Local published attack-row identifier; not a physical weapon mount

attackBonus.description: Total printed bonus, not an additive bonus to BAB

damageExpression.description: Printed damage exactly; not a generated weapon definition

weaponComponentId.description: Exact installed weapon instance ID if certified Never inferred from name alone.

vehicleAttackGroupKey.description: Vehicle firing-group key for published vehicle-format droid Never inferred from name alone.

condition.description: Printed prerequisites/conditions; no inferred permission to execute

operationStatus.description: No stock attack unlocked by a printed row

locomotionInstance.description: Independent locomotion entry; multiple systems coexist without invented extra movement actions.

mode.description: walking/wheeled/tracked/hovering/flying/etc exactly or normalized with printed raw

restricted.description: Restricted locomotion classification only if printed

requiresAction.description: Source-specific engage/disengage or alternative mode transition

componentInstanceId.description: Link to installed component instance Never inferred from name alone.

capacityQuantity.description: Capacity is not equipment slot count, component mount count, or carrying strength.

context.description: Internal vs external storage vs lift vs hold etc
